Fixed menu xxx Would try a la carte.
Sep 2026 • Couples
Dinner was included with our tour so expectation was not high. Upon arriving I noticed it was listed with Michelin (not rated). We received the set menu which looked amazing.
Whilst the food was nice my expectation was higher, flavours where not as pronounced to what I was expecting.
Service for food was spasmodic with the main course (chicken, veg, rice and Pork/ ribs soup) being served over 5 mons with chicken served last, accompaniments now cold.
Beverage service was terrible with you all but having to tackle a waitperson to get an order. Stock levels also where scary with an adjoining I g table having to change their beers 3 times.due to no stock.available.
Was it good yes, was it exceptio al definatly no. Better food in roadside eateries.
If you are eating upstairs the stairway is very steep.

lizzief2024
Brisbane, Australia19 contributions
0
Dreadful
Aug 2025 • Couples
I am afraid this restaurant is under new management. We booked based on the website's menu, restaurant's reputation and reviews. The menu was absolutely nothing like the the menu we searched hours before. In fact, it was approximately 1/3 of the size with dishes which were perplexing at best. We considered leaving but wanted to give them a chance. We ordered a cocktail and it was very nice. The food however was a discombobulated disaster. My Norwegian salmon was paired with mushroom reduction with some weird addition, passionfruit sauce and truffle potato. It was overcooked even though I asked for medium rare. My husband's smoked duck risotto came with a tablespoon of rice which was green. The duck was cooked relatively well and the orange sauce was ok. Nothing else with it. The staff did a great job despite the adversity and were resilient and polite. A credit to them under the circumstances!! Our waiter did his absolute best. No manager to be seen. Bitterly disappointing.

5 stars in Hanoi

Wish I had had time to do a cooking class.
